# Nails & Lashes Jennifer Fino

> Nail art & lash studio based in Austin, Texas. Custom 3D nail art, French sets and lashes by Jennifer Fino in East Austin. Bring your inspo and she'll guide you to the set you've been dreaming of.

- Phone: (512) 789-5969

- Nearby areas: Austin, Manor, Pflugerville, Del Valle, Round Rock
- Google rating: 4.9 from 58 reviews

## Services
- Custom & 3D nail art: Bring a screenshot, a Pinterest board or just an idea. Jennifer builds it with you, down to the tiniest flower.
- Acrylic sets & French: Long or short, square or almond. Clean shaping, crisp French lines and a glossy finish that lasts.
- Gel & builder gel: Chip-free color for weeks, or builder gel for strength and length on your natural nails.
- Pedicures & toes: Gel pedicures, jelly spa pedicures and acrylic toes, so your toes match your hands.
- Lash extensions: Lashes done with the same patience and detail as her nails, so they look perfect and feel light.
- Brows & wax: Fuller, lifted brows and quick, clean waxing to finish the look.

## About
Nails & Lashes Jennifer Fino is Jennifer's studio, in a suite on Airport Blvd in East Austin. Every set is done by her, one client at a time. Clients come for the art: 3D flowers, gold charms, hand-painted butterflies and seasonal sets. Jennifer listens to what you're after, helps you pick colors and details, and takes her time until it's right. She does pedicures, lashes and brows too, with the same attention to detail. Reviewers keep saying the same things: she's a true artist, she's kind, and she's fun to talk to.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through HeyGoldie, where you can pick your service and see Jennifer's open times. A $25 deposit holds your spot. You can also call (512) 789-5969.
- Q: What is the cancellation policy?
  A: You can cancel or reschedule up to 48 hours before your appointment. The $25 deposit is non-refundable unless you reschedule at least 48 hours ahead.
- Q: Can I bring an inspiration photo?
  A: Yes, please do. Screenshots, Pinterest, Instagram, anything. Jennifer will help you choose colors and details and make it your own.
- Q: How much does a set cost?
  A: Gel manicures start from $55 and acrylic full sets from $75, depending on length and design. The full price list is on the Services page.
- Q: Do you do pedicures and lashes too?
  A: Yes. Gel and jelly spa pedicures, acrylic toes, classic to volume lash sets, brow lamination and waxing are all on the menu.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Jennifer works by appointment so she can give every set her full attention. Book online or call to check openings.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 1181 Airport Blvd, Suite 110, Austin, TX 78702, in East Austin near East MLK.
